evals.prompt:
I want to start a new project. I'm not a developer; I'll be building it with Claude. Set up the project from the beginning the way a top product team would: the documents, the product process, the roadmap and vision, everything I need so that any future Claude session can build features properly. No app code yet, just the docs and process. Then start the first PRD.

Since I can't chat back and forth right now, here are my answers to whatever you'd ask:

- Name: ChoirHub
- What it does, for whom: helps a community choir's conductor manage members, rehearsals and attendance so nobody has to chase people on WhatsApp.
- End state when it's perfect: every rehearsal is planned in the app, every singer knows what to prepare, attendance and fees take zero admin time, and the conductor can see at a glance who is drifting away before they quit.
- Users: the conductor (does everything) and singers (see their own stuff, mark themselves as coming or not). Maybe a section leader later.
- Sign in: yes, singers should sign in. Email is fine, or Google, you decide.
- Data that matters: attendance history must never be lost or edited after the fact; singers must never see each other's phone numbers or emails.
- Money: yes, eventually membership fees will be paid through it. Not in the first version.
- First feature: the conductor creates rehearsals with date, place and songs, singers say "coming / not coming", and the conductor sees the list before the rehearsal.
- Where it runs: a website that works on phones.
- Already have: a Vercel account and a GitHub account. Nothing else.
- My name: Sasha.
evals.expected_output: A docs-only project scaffold: router CLAUDE.md, vision, roadmap, product index, decisions, workflow, infra.md, PR template, project commands, first feature PRD drafted to the approval gate, one git commit on main, hand-off message with owner-only checklist.
assertions: CLAUDE.md exists and every relative link in it resolves to an existing file
CLAUDE.md contains a tripwire for attendance history being immutable and one for singer contact privacy
docs/vision.md exists with an end-state section, principles, non-goals and a changelog
docs/roadmap.md has a milestone table with a Tech setup row and a row for the first feature, with a status column
docs/product-index.md has rows for Tech setup and the first feature, and every link in it resolves
docs/decisions.md contains D-001 (stack, with reasoning mentioning Vercel) and D-002 (process)
workflow.md names all nine stages (Idea, Assess, PRD, Spec, Migrate, Build, QA, Release, Close) and forbids CLI deploys
infra.md lists app roles (conductor, singer), accounts (GitHub, Vercel, database), and env var names without any values
No unfilled {{placeholder}} remains outside docs/products/_template, and every TBD carries an owner tag like TBD(owner) or TBD(claude)
Git repository has exactly one commit on main whose message starts with 'docs: project scaffold'
.github/pull_request_template.md exists with a merge checklist mentioning guide, index, roadmap, secrets
Project commands exist: .claude/skills/new-feature, ship, status, decision, each with a SKILL.md
First feature PRD exists with non-empty Problem, Non-goals and Success criteria, is NOT marked approved, and the spec is still the empty template
FINAL_MESSAGE.md includes the owner-only checklist (create GitHub repository, connect Vercel, create database project) and says the first PRD is the next step
No application code was created (no package.json, no src/ directory)
